item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"read\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"report.json\"}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"diff\",\"--\",\"work.py\",\"report.json\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-m\",\"py_compile\",\"work.py\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json; from work import evaluate; cases=[({'declared':['b','a','a','skip'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'1','meta':{'x':1}},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'},'skip':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'},'extra':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'}},'current':{'a':{'meta':{'x':1},'hash':'1','kind':'file'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'3'},'skip':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'},'extra':{'kind':'file','hash':'y'}}},{'ignored':['skip']},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['b']}),({'declared':['x'],'saved':{},'current':{'x':{'kind':'missing'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'h','mtime':1}},'current':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'h','mtime':2}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['x']})];\\nfor req,pol,want in cases:\\n rb,pb=copy.deepcopy(req),copy.deepcopy(pol); got=evaluate(req,pol); assert got==want,(got,want); assert req==rb and pol==pb\\nprint(json.dumps([evaluate(r,p) for r,p,_ in cases],sort_keys=True))\"]}}]}"}
